component.name: Cloudy AF
component.summary: Configuration tool for Arcticfox firmware vape mods

description.p: Arcticfox Config is a desktop configuration tool for vape battery mods running the Arcticfox firmware. It allows you to read and write device settings, edit profiles, power curves, TFR tables, and battery profiles over USB.

Complete translations for all 17 locales (key-complete language files plus the previously English-only tooltip text), tooltips for the Advanced and Screen sub-tabs, and the Device Monitor button relocated to the Stats tab.

Recovery tooling: "Repair Product ID" fixes a device whose dataflash product ID was erased or rewritten by the wrong stock firmware (crash-loop / not detected after flashing), flash progress reaches the status line in all paths, and STM32-line device coverage is broadened (M149/M172/M177). Also: flasher restart-retry after a successful write, and documentation of the device's two USB modes and dataflash layout.

Flash reliability: firmware is padded to whole flash rows so the updater no longer dies on a ragged final chunk, and applying a timeout animation also writes the config byte that enables it. Flashes now tolerate devices that won't soft-switch into bootloader mode (e.g. Pico Dual): the app waits for an unplug/replug and reports progress live. Firmware Editor auto-loads the stock firmware for the connected device, "Download Stock" is now "Download FW", and Device Monitor adds a pause button and Space shortcut.

Sidecar crash fixed (node-hid handle freed while a read was in flight) — Firmware Editor and Device Monitor no longer die with a device plugged in. Timeout animations now actually appear under Firmware Editor → Patches. Device Monitor chart: hover any point for its value, restyled as an NToolbox-style Highcharts port. App follows the system dark/light theme. Configuration dropdown double-arrow fixed.

iStick Rim C support (STM32 line) and the full NFE device catalog (69 devices). Device Monitor no longer crashes the HID sidecar and streams live telemetry; "Download Stock" works while connected. Device Monitor temperature readings fixed: the firmware reports whole degrees, not tenths.

Accessibility tooltips on every setting, written for screen-reader and low-vision users. Live Device Monitor under Advanced (NToolbox port). Charge-screen timeout animations (Gradient Fade, Center Pulse, Diagonal Sweep) as a firmware patch for af_190602, verified in an emulator before flashing. Fix for zoom fit at startup clipping the tab bar.

Controls Shortcuts (VW/TC) rearranged into a NToolbox-style 2x2 grid; Puff Cut-Off now steps in whole seconds. Screen Layout page shows only the active skin's fields, with all five ArcticFox skins (Small/Medium added for 64x128 displays).

Emergency recovery now accepts encrypted ArcticFox firmware files and decrypts them before flashing. Bundled decrypted firmware images for inspection and patching. Shortened recovery tab instructions.

Fixed a firmware-flash race that could brick devices (single-instance enforcement, whole-upload retry, sidecar crash fix). Recovery tab now auto-loads the bundled original manufacturer firmware and offers the matching ArcticFox build afterwards.

Added Firmware Editor Recovery tab, support for all 47 ArcticFox-compatible device Product IDs, in-app VandalProof firmware decryption, and bundled stock firmware library. Fixed STM32-line firmware opening and Flatpak resource bundling.
Added Firmware Editor window with Patches tab for opening, patching, saving, and flashing ArcticFox firmware binaries. Added Undo Changes backup restore.
Fixed Advanced Materials list to show each TFR table as [TFR] <name> and updated the TFR curve editor chart to match the original NToolbox spline plot.
Renamed all runtime and packaging references from arcticfox-config to cloudy-af for consistent branding.
Flatpak permission hardening: removed the WebKit sandbox bypass, removed Flatpak spawn access, and allowed native Wayland use.
